notes.title: Fixes & Improvements: 3-15-18
notes.notes:
Hello survivors! Pale Lands VR has just wrapped it's launch week on Steam Early Access. We are happy with our launch and hope that you are happy with your purchase! 

Since launching our team has been working hard to implement some missing features and to address some of the problems that have been encountered. Below is a summary of the fixes and features included in this new build. We have been hearing (no pun intended) that some people are having issues with the audio not playing. We have not encountered these internally and would appreciate people with these problems to give us some more info to properly track down this problem.

If you happen to have issues with the HMD display, please make sure you have "asynchronous reprojection" turned on in your Steam VR Settings.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Steam Achievements Added[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Sniper:[/b] While using Pistols, achieve 10 Headshots in a row
[*][b]The Man with No Name:[/b] While using Pistols, achieve 100 Headshots in a row
[*][b]Marksman:[/b] While using a Longbow, achieve 10 Headshots in a row
[*][b]Robin Hood:[/b] While using a Longbow, achieve 100 Headshots in a row
[*][b]Bloody Mess:[/b] Using one dynamite, kill 2 or more zombies
[*][b]Viscera Showers:[/b] Using one dynamite, kill 5 or more zombies
[*][b]The Hunter:[/b] Kill 5 or more zombies with one Gas Tank
[*][b]The Butcher:[/b] Kill 10 or more zombies with one Gas Tank
[*][b]The Ravager:[/b] Kill 20 or more zombies with one Gas Tank
[*][b]The Exterminator:[/b] Kill 30 or more zombies with one Gas Tank
[*][b]Walking Dead:[/b] Player dies 10 times
[*][b]Mind of Matter:[/b] Teleport between towers 10 times
[*][b]Master of Motion Sickness:[/b] Teleport between towers 100 times
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Made Win/Loss More Clear[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated win/loss effects
[*]Added "Game Over" and "You Win" text to the score screen
[/list]
[*][b]Buildings now have visual indication of health level[/b]
[list]
[*]New models for collapsed state were added
[*]New FX added
[/list]
[*][b]Added text FX when the player achieves a headshot[/b]
[list]
[*]Includes the current Headshot Combo Count
[/list]
[*][b]Added a Laser Guide for Teleportation[/b]
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Killing zombies early no longer completes the stage
[*]Zombies no longer get "stuck" in the stage Day 2: High Noon
[*]Giant can no longer overlap with the results screen
[*]Zombies no longer rotate when hit with a chicken leg arrow
[*]Spitter zombies now always face the correct direction when attacking
[*]Replaced the UI navigation text "Main" with "Home"
[*]Map name in UI now shows correct level name and not debug text
[/list]
Thank you for your support!
❤ BiNAREE

notes.title: Launch Sale FINAL Day!
notes.notes:
Today is the last day for the launch sale of Pale Lands VR! If you haven't purchased yet but are considering picking it up, ACT NOW! We have been pleased with the response we've been getting from the community and hope to include more fans of our game.

We have also added support for Oculus Rift! So if you are a Rift owner who was considering purchase, now you can get in on the zombie slaying mayhem.

notes.title: Pale Lands VR Arises on Early Access!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31986549/7c6ef4a3123abd330e3ab97436612189c5a8ec21.jpg[/img]
Welcome survivors! We are excited to announce that Pale Lands VR is now available on Steam! To share our excitement, we are launching Pale Lands VR with a 40% discount for the first week. Plus, you will get to be one of the first adopters to our game and help guide it's development during Early Access. Check it out today!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1301033128]We got zombies![/url] Five types of uniquely mutated zombies for you to fight off.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1308453072]We got weapons![/url] Two interactive weapons with customizable ammo to protect the town.
We got four stages for you to test your skills on!

This is our teams first launch onto Steam, so we do have a few issues with our current build that we are aware of. The most severe problems are listed below. We are hoping to have these issues resolved within a couple of weeks of launch. If you encounter any issues or have any feedback, please let us know. We care about your feedback and want to make sure you are satisfied with your purchase. You can also get more updates about our development on [url=https://twitter.com/BiNAREE_Games]Twitter[/url] and  [url=https://www.facebook.com/palelands/]Facebook[/url].

Thank you for your support!

❤ BiNAREE

[h1]Known Problems[/h1]
[list]
[*]On Day 2: High Noon, the last wave of zombies sometimes get stuck preventing you from completing the level
[*]It is possible for the game objects to overlap with the UI making some menus difficult to read or interact with
[*]There are issues when teleporting while holding the longbow
[*]Scoreboard values may change after you have been defeated
[*]Score on scoreboard does not always reflect the correct value
[*]Some zombie animation & ai issues
[*]Some minor issues with UI and compatibility
[/list]

notes.title: Pale Lands VR is coming!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31986549/c8508a4950b9bd3a0a0f62c1f2199666dd51e578.jpg[/img]

Prepare yourself! Pale Lands VR will be creeping into Early Access on Steam in early March. Our team at BiNAREE are hard at work preparing the wild world of Pale Lands for the upcoming launch. Our aim is to deliver a more lighthearted approach to a zombie apocalypse which focuses on action with some strategic depth all in an immersive VR world. We are excited to be releasing on Steam and look forward to further building and improving the game along with the community! We welcome you to join us in growing the world of Pale Lands!

As an added bonus, Pale Lands VR will launch in Early Access with a [b]40% discount[/b]!!! This sale will only run for the first week from our launch so be sure to follow us on Steam for updates about our launch. You can also get more updates about our development on [url=https://twitter.com/BiNAREE_Games]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/palelands/]Facebook[/url].

As we near launch we plan to update the community with development news and some game guides to give you a sneak peek of the game content. Please do keep in mind that we are making a more arcade style game on a limited budget. As such, we encourage any and all ideas from the community but LOVE practical ideas that will make the game more enjoyable for all players. This is also our team's first Steam release! Which is exciting, but it also means we will likely have some hiccups along the way to release, so please, have patience with us!

Thank you for your support!

♥ BiNAREE
